title: 第25章 血案夜晚的袭击者第26章 灰雾哥布林
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
菲尔德把咀嚼了一半的苹果块喷了出来，哈哈大笑。
居然有人敢对丑陋的女怪物下手，太离谱了。
和现代人的取向一样，只要是母的，就会有人喜欢。
抹掉眼角因为狂笑挤出来的眼泪，菲尔德产生了好奇。
腐化会让人与人产生生殖隔离吗？
“可怜的钢叉，最后死于下身溃烂，他的大山雀，变成了一团恶心的瘤子，走的时候非常痛苦。腐化本就是魔鬼的诅咒，钢叉可能上不了天堂了。除了神选中的人，我想没有任何生物，能抵御诅咒。”
菲尔德合上书本，通篇的感觉类词汇，让菲尔德暂时不想阅读。
“卢卡斯只能算一个冒险者或是探索者，作为学者，他缺乏严谨性。并非所有生物都无法抵抗腐化，至少植物可以。”
菲尔德想起了朗姆村收集的绿色植物，它们并非肉块或是触手。
“啊！”
窗外传来一声尖叫，菲尔德手一晃，差点将举到嘴边的茶杯碰翻，其中冒着热气的茶水泼下来，烫到自己不说，湿漉漉的衣服在夜幕领，是很难晾干的。
菲尔德瞥了眼小地图，并没有骷髅头标志。
“看来又是哪个欠收拾的蠢货，控制不住下半身。”菲尔德揉揉太阳穴，奴隶们都混在一起，暴力和强迫事件总会有发生的时候，哪怕鞭子也难以改变本性。
奴隶没有交配的权利，不过绝大部分奴隶连饭都吃不饱，也没心思传宗接代。
“大人！”
听得走廊外一阵小跑，男仆瓦罐急促地敲响了房门。
“进来，什么事？”菲尔德来到窗外瞥了一眼，外面依旧黑漆漆的，楼下的火把竖起来了，但菲尔德只能看到一些惊慌失措的面孔，出现在火把旁边。
看来事情要更严重。
瓦罐匍匐在地，颤抖地说道“大人，我们领地碰上了大麻烦！”
菲尔德一阵心焦，但依旧保持镇定“别急，说一下什么麻烦。”

“强盗！是武装强盗攻击了我们的领地！”瓦罐毕竟年纪还小，他惊恐地不能自已，撑着地面的双手抖得和帕金森一样，“有几个奴隶去农田排泄，突然遭到了从灰雾中冲出来的强盗攻击，他们用长矛杀死了两人，还抓走了一个女奴隶！”
菲尔德急忙上前一步，惊讶的询问道“没有继续攻击，而是选择了撤退吗？”
“是的，他们立刻离开了。”
“真是草了！”菲尔德怒骂一声。
会撤退，必然拥有一定智慧。自己在这个鸟不拉屎、充满毒素的破地方，还能碰上强盗，还有比这更离谱的事吗？
或许是自己“可爱”的后妈和兄弟姐妹。
有这个可能，要是让他们获得神选者的情报，那就危险了。
菲尔德又看了眼小地图，并没有异样。
这让菲尔德想起了康纳的骑兵，他们是靠近到一定距离，才显示感叹号。
content_en:
Field laughed as he spat out the half-chewed apple chunks.
It's outrageous that someone would dare to attack an ugly female monster.
Just like the orientation of modern people, as long as it is female, someone will like it.
Wiping away the tears from the corners of his eyes because of the wild laughter, Field became curious.
Does corruption create reproductive isolation between people?
"Poor Steel Fork finally died of ulcers on his lower body. His big tits turned into a disgusting tumor. It was very painful when he left. Corruption is the devil's curse. Steel Fork may not be able to go to heaven. Except for the people chosen by God, I don't think any living thing can resist the curse."
Field closed the book. The sensory words throughout the article made Field not want to read for the time being.
"Lucas can only be regarded as an adventurer or explorer. As a scholar, he lacks rigor. Not all creatures are immune to corruption, at least plants can."
Field thought of the green plants collected in Rum Village, which were not chunks of flesh or tentacles.
"Ah!"
There was a scream outside the window. Field waved his hand and almost knocked over the teacup he raised to his mouth. The steaming tea poured down and burned himself. It was difficult to dry wet clothes at night.
Field glanced at the small map, but there was no skull symbol.
"Looks like another idiot who is in trouble and can't control his lower body." Field rubbed his temples. The slaves were all mixed together. Violence and coercion would always happen, and even a whip could not change his nature.
Slaves did not have the right to mate, but most slaves did not even have enough to eat and had no intention of continuing the family line.
"My lord!"
A trot was heard outside the corridor, and the servant Cun Guan knocked on the door hastily.
"Come in, what's going on?" Field came to the window and took a look. It was still dark outside. The torch downstairs was erected, but Field could only see some panicked faces appearing next to the torch.
It seems things are more serious.
Cun Gu was lying on the ground and said tremblingly, "Sir, our territory is in big trouble!"
Field was anxious for a while, but still remained calm: "Don't worry, tell me what's the trouble."
"Bandits! Armed robbers attacked our territory!" Cuguan was still young after all. He couldn't control himself with fear. His hands on the ground were shaking like Parkinson's. "A few slaves went to the farmland to relieve themselves. They were suddenly attacked by bandits who rushed out of the gray mist. They killed two people with spears and captured a female slave!"
Field hurriedly stepped forward and asked in surprise, "Did you choose to retreat instead of continuing to attack?"
"Yes, they left immediately."
"It's so stupid!" Field yelled angrily.
If you can retreat, you must have certain wisdom. I could encounter robbers in this shabby place full of toxins. Is there anything more outrageous than this?
Maybe it's his "cute" stepmother and siblings.
There is this possibility, and it would be dangerous if they were allowed to obtain information about the Chosen One.
Field looked at the small map again, but there was nothing strange.
This reminded Field of Connor's cavalry. They only displayed the exclamation mark when they got close to a certain distance.
